citations.claim: pole exceeded upright limit at first violating step, energy 5.9J
one step before violation pole still within limit

explanation: Coarse dt=0.02 with max sensor noise and offset initial state destabilizes the feedback loop: noisy angle feedback plus large integration step causes growing oscillation (theta -0.41 at step 10 to -0.77 at step 13) until pole exceeds 0.8 rad at step 14.
vision_note: The pole leans increasingly far to the left from steps 11 to 13 while the cart stays near the center of the track. At step 14 the pole tip turns red, marking the pole exceeding the upright limit.
